Knives, boards, pots, rice, miso, dried <ruby>mackerel<rt>horse mackerel</rt></ruby>: I thought all had existed five hundred years ago.

en.html:
Muramasa"...Lovely weather."
Kageaki"If it were always like this, winter would be tolerable."
Muramasa"Dislike the cold?"
Kageaki"As much as anyone."
Kageaki"Heat troubles me more..."
Muramasa"I used to dislike cold more. Being a tsurugilike this now, neither bothers me."
Kageaki"People say you can dress warmly and heat a room in winter, but summer remains unbearable however little you wear. No such saying in your time?"
Muramasa"No... But I understand."
Muramasa"Still..."
Kageaki"Hm?"
Muramasa"Keep using fire because you're cold, and the expense mounts. Really. Winter means choosing warmth with less to eat, or the reverse."
Muramasa"Not many happy memories of winter."
Kageaki"Ah... I see."

en.html:
Muramasa"Summer heat, on the other hand—nothing to be done, so you accept it from the beginning."
Kageaki"Opposite way of thinking."
Muramasa"Well... still..."
Kageaki"Yes."
Muramasa"Spring and autumn are better, obviously."
Kageaki"Quite."
Muramasa"Somewhere across the sea, there are countries with eternal spring, aren't there?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Muramasa"Lovely to live there."
Kageaki"Yes. Though... a little lonely, perhaps."
Muramasa"...Right. No changing seasons to enjoy."
Kageaki"Losing summer nights and winter scenery would be a pity."
Muramasa"So acceptance matters. Start demanding luxuries and there's no end?"
Kageaki"Who knows? Science may someday let us choose any season we like."
Kageaki"Every demand fulfilled. A triumph of human wisdom."
Muramasa"Yes."
Kageaki"Indeed."
Muramasa"..."
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"Isn't that... actually losing while thinking we've won?"

en.html:
Trivial conversation.
Less moving our mouths to talk than talking to keep our mouths moving.

And walking. Aimlessly.
Time without purpose. But not, I thought, without value.
I wanted to continue like this.
